safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not document denial of thoughts of self-harm.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documentation of suicidal/self-harm ideation is a key safety element; omission of a denial can lead to uncertainty about risk assessment, unnecessary escalation, or missed recognition that the question was addressed. This is higher-risk than routine history elements because it pertains to immediate patient safety and follow-up decisions.
